content: Validation errors in htmx apps: server returns 422 with the re-rendered form fragment (typed values echoed back into value= attributes, per-field error text next to each field, aria-invalid + aria-describedby). Client must be configured to swap 422 (default does not). Target the FORM (or a form-body wrapper), never the whole page. Alternatives: HX-Retarget to redirect the response to an error region, or the response-targets extension. 422 is the semantically right code for form validation; 400 also common.
